errors.text_span: For GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar reaches a height of 554 words while the TLDR bar reaches 2861 words; for MATH500, the heights are 4510 and 2861 words respectively; for AIME, the values are 6820 and 4510 words; and for AMC, the values are approximately 7200 and 5500 words.
errors.evidence: The description completely misreports the values for the bars, mixing up values from different categories. For example, for GSM8K, it correctly states the Vanilla CoT value is 554 but incorrectly states the TLDR value is 2861 (which is the Vanilla CoT value for MATH500). The actual TLDR value for GSM8K is approximately 255 (a 54% reduction from 554). This pattern of misattribution continues for all other categories.

errors.text_span: Percentage changes are annotated above the Vanilla CoT bars for each dataset
errors.evidence: The percentage change values (-54%, -46%, -7%, -25%) are shown next to the dark red TLDR (Ours) bars, not the light red Vanilla CoT bars.
